local Players = game:GetService("Players")

screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

local jumpscareImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
jumpscareImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
jumpscareImage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
jumpscareImage.Image = "rbxassetid://6030064516" -- Replace with a scary Image ID
jumpscareImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
jumpscareImage.Visible = false
jumpscareImage.Parent = screenGui

-- 2. Create the Ear-Piercing Sound
local scream = Instance.new("Sound")
scream.SoundId = "rbxassetid://5567501633" -- Replace with a loud Sound ID
scream.Volume = 10 -- Maxing out volume for the troll
scream.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- 3. The "Loading" Bait (To make them think it's working)
print("Loading Delta Premium Hub...")
task.wait(2)
print("Checking License...")
task.wait(1.5)
print("Authenticated! Initializing...")

-- 4. THE JUMPSCARE

-- Optional: Shake the camera
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
for i = 1, 50 do
    local x = math.random(-10, 10) / 100
    local y = math.random(-10, 10) / 100
    cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * CFrame.new(x, y, 0)
    task.wait(0.01)
end

-- Clean up after 3 seconds
task.wait(3)
screenGui:Destroy()
scream:Destroy()
